decisions.decision: Applicant to look at options for pedestrian walkway and vehicle/pedestrian conflict from the upper parking lot to the restaurant.
decisions.quote: k. chenis is concerned with vehicles entering the site and pedestrians walking from the upper parking lot down to the restaurant.. applicant to look at options.

decisions.decision: Applicant to look at making the areas where individuals park illegally unattractive for parking; G. Bittner wants a complete proposal including parking and seating.
decisions.quote: g. bittner would like to see a complete proposal to include parking and seating.

decisions.decision: Applicant to file a Notice of Intent with the Conservation Commission and appear before that commission for minor work within the 100 foot buffer zone.
decisions.quote: the applicant will appear before the conservation commission as there will be some minor work within the 100 foot buffer zone.

decisions.decision: D. Prokowiew requested an elevation drawing of the building front from the applicant.
decisions.quote: d. prokowiew would like an elevation drawing of ===page 2=== minute

decisions.decision: Applicant to address the lot coverage note on the dimensional requirement chart (page 3 of the site plan).
decisions.quote: m. allison commented that the dimensional requirement chart on page 3 of the site plan does not note lot coverage. r. oliva to look at.

decisions.decision: Revised plans to add tree specifics, two bicycle spaces, a fence along the top of the wall over four feet, and a surveyor's stamp on Sheet 2.
decisions.quote: tree specifics will be added to the revised plans.

decisions.decision: Applicant to look at the safety of the restaurant entrance in regards to patrons and vehicles, and to provide plantings between the parking lot and the abutter for screening.
decisions.quote: the applicant will look at the safety of the restaurant entrance in regards to patrons and vehicles

decisions.decision: Action items summarized for the applicant and Board: recharge, drainage, interior layout and use of restaurant addition, landscaping, and pedestrian access from the upper parking lot.
decisions.quote: summarization was provided to the applicant and board as to action items- issue of recharge, drainage, interior layout and use
